اشتعلنا (form VIII)
# اِشْتَعَلْنَا (ištaʕalnā) /iʃ.ta.ʕal.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
# اُشْتُعِلْنَا (uštuʕilnā) /uʃ.tu.ʕil.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
